_doc: Future backend contracts the V0 mock models so an approved experience can be designed before the backend has it. Each entry names the backend finding in docs/architecture/CONTEXT-RECONCILIATION.md. The mock honours these only when a scenario sets flags.v0; the Legacy reference tier keeps refusing what the backend refuses. A design record that depends on one of these is `conceptual` until the contract lands and the field moves into contract/.

fields.type: { pipeline: { draft, review, changes, sent, filed, declined }, company: { submitted_this_quarter, reached_filing } } (numeric counts, GET /v1/dashboard, V0 Inventor only)
fields.reason: DSN-0005: personal pipeline is counted across all own/credited ideas by the server, never from a list page. Company momentum contains only aggregate counts within the Inventor's company: submissions in the current calendar quarter and ideas that reached filing across all time. No named ranking or other inventors' idea details are exposed.
Separate Inventor and Submitted by attribution when a Workspace Admin submits on behalf of an inventor (product-context/WORKFLOWS.md section 5). Null when the primary inventor submitted.
A Workspace Admin selects the real primary inventor when starting an idea on their behalf. Requires idea:create and idea:submit for LEGAL_COUNSEL, which GRANTS does not carry today.

Workspace-scoped aggregates for the Workspace Admin dashboard (DSN-0002): awaiting_review, oldest_waiting_days, actions_due_30_days, next_action_due_at, submitted_this_quarter, submitted_last_quarter, quarter_start, quarter_end, patents_filed_this_quarter, and idea_pipeline for this_quarter, last_quarter and all_time. Each number links to a filtered list; the backend must expose the same filter parameters so the link lands on the identical list. Nothing is counted in the browser from a paged list.

fields.type: { this_month: Row[]; this_quarter: Row[]; last_quarter: Row[]; this_year: Row[]; all_time: Row[] } where Row = { id, name, ideas, patents } (GET /v1/dashboard, V0 scenarios only)
fields.reason: Top inventors by ideas submitted and by patents filed, per period, for the Workspace Admin dashboard (DSN-0002 founder override keeps the ranking). Names only, never identifiers to the reader.

fields.type: Array<{ jurisdiction, count }> (GET /v1/dashboard, V0 scenarios only)
fields.reason: The jurisdiction list that is the text alternative of the Patents worldwide panel and the subtitle's jurisdiction count (DSN-0002).

fields.type: version number; frozen submitted revisions with answers; retained source text and filenames; ai/edited/you provenance
fields.reason: DSN-0006: one canonical disclosure with optimistic concurrency through answers.__expected_version, retained source material, visible human/AI provenance and frozen reviewed revisions. V0 only; existing draft routes and adapter remain intact.

fields.type: Array of stored file metadata / string
fields.reason: DSN-0008: retain and retrieve supporting attachments with the invention disclosure. The V0 mock associates uploads through POST /v1/ideas/:id/files and exposes only the linked stored files on the idea.

fields.type: Internal answer fingerprint and revision / { revision, evaluated_at, is_current } or null
fields.reason: DSN-0008 evaluator: preserve evaluation attribution and freshness after edits and resubmission. The mock captures the answer-text fingerprint and review revision when evaluation starts, compares saved answers when hydrating the draft, and exposes the date, revision and freshness. Save metadata alone does not make the evaluation stale. No raw fingerprint is rendered.
DSN-0009: Photon Ideas list needs Case Owner context beside each client. Derived from existing assigned client scope; no assignment or permission changes.

DSN-0013: associate stored same-client uploads with the patent using its existing update flow. The mock had a files response but ignored the existing component documents body, leaving successful uploads unattached. Only Case Owner and Photon Admin within client scope can maintain associations. No new route or persona.

collections.name: emails
collections.reason: The activation and reminder sequences of product-context/WORKFLOWS.md section 9 are V0 requirements; the backend has no mailer. The outbox lets the design show what a person received and why. Nothing is sent.

policies.name: inventor-no-docket
policies.reason: Inventors never see due dates or Actions (product-context/PERSONAS.md, SCREENS.md). The backend serves both to any authenticated role scoped to its client, and production's dashboard shows upcoming due dates to inventors. V0 hides them in the interface; the backend should refuse them so the interface is not the only barrier.
